name: Church Apps UK
shortDescription: A UK church-app service offering branded Android, iOS, HTML5 and progressive web app options, with messaging, media and church-content features.
suitableContexts: Churches seeking a branded member-facing mobile app
Multi-location churches wanting a mobile-app option
Teams that need app notifications, podcast or video connections alongside a church website

pricing.summary: Church Apps UK publishes monthly and annual GBP plans with setup fees. The public price page contains repeated and inconsistently labelled content, so a church should obtain a current written quote that confirms platform coverage, app-store costs, support and renewal terms.

startingPrice.qualifier: Starter App monthly price shown by the supplier, plus a £150 setup fee

tiers.detail: Supplier describes Android, HTML5 and PWA options with basic support

tiers.detail: Supplier describes custom Android, HTML5 and PWA app options

tiers.label: Enterprise App
tiers.detail: Internal staff/team app option described for churches with more than 25 staff or team members

gdprInformation: Church Apps UK publishes a website privacy policy, but the version reviewed is dated 2017 and refers to the Data Protection Act 1998. It is not sufficient evidence of current UK GDPR product terms, hosting, sub-processors, app data flows or retention. Obtain current service-specific documentation before processing member data.
coreFeatures: Branded Android, iOS, HTML5 and PWA app options depending on plan
integrations: Supplier describes podcast-channel and YouTube-channel connections
Supplier describes Instagram, Flickr and Picasa gallery links
support: Priority support stated on higher plans

uk-purchasing.value: Supplier terms identify MediaWorkx Ltd, company number 10274151, as the England and Wales operating company.

published-pricing.value: Supplier publishes GBP setup fees and recurring monthly or annual app plans.

mobile-platforms.value: Supplier describes Android, iOS, HTML5 and progressive web app options across its plans.

editorial.assessment: Church Apps UK is a specialist UK option for a church that has a clear reason to offer a branded app rather than only a responsive website. Its published plans make it a reasonable candidate for a practical quote, but the older privacy material and inconsistent price-page presentation mean that app-store ownership, data processing, platform scope and renewal charges should be settled in writing before a church commissions it.
bestFor: Churches with a defined need for branded member-facing mobile access
Teams seeking a UK provider for Android, iOS, HTML5 or PWA options
Multi-location churches that want an app layer for communications and media
strengths: Published GBP recurring prices and setup fees
Public terms identify a UK limited company
Supplier describes several mobile platform options and church-oriented media and notification features
limitations: The pricing page contains repeated and inconsistent labels, so current scope and costs need a written quote
Ask the supplier about Current service-specific UK GDPR documentation, hosting, sub-processors and data-export arrangements
An app creates a recurring content and app-store-management responsibility that should not be assumed to sit with the supplier

procurementVerdict.problem: Giving members a genuinely useful branded mobile route to church news, media and notifications
procurementVerdict.differentiator: UK church-app specialist offering native, web-app and internal-team options
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Confirm app-store ownership, current plan scope, data processing, support response and the cost of future platform updates in writing
